{{Quote|Sound alert, all hands to battle stations. Send an emergency signal to the nearest naval base. I'll be right up.|Unidentified Rinkin IV captain|<ref name="MK" />}}
This  '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Navy]] support-and-supply division.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> she was serving aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] '' [[Rinkin IV]]'' on its way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] when the ship was suddenly pulled out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The ship's [[Unidentified Ortolan pilot (Rinkin IV)|pilot]] quickly attempted to determine their position and noticed that none of their escorts had emerged with them except for an unknown capital ship. He reported this to the captain via the [[Comm board|comm board]], who then ordered the [[Unidentified Human navigator (Rinkin IV)|navigator]] to send a distress signal over the ship's [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] using an emergency naval frequency. As the captain made her way onto the bridge, a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] was thrown in their direction, prompting the navigator to bravely leap onto it and cover it with his body. However, it failed to explode, as it was in fact a [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenade]] that rendered everyone on the bridge unconscious. The captain then collapsed onto the navigator's limp body.<ref name="MK" />
